messages:
support-jay: FYI — AcmeCorp opened an urgent ticket: repeated 502/504s and streaming timeouts against hosted inference endpoint `/v1/generate` from ~03:18-03:45 UTC. They see p95 latency spikes and client-side disconnects. Customer attached a trace and example request.

support-jay: Example request they used: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwf-open-13b","input":"<large-payload>"}'```

ops-bot: ALERT: gateway.5xx.rate >= 240/min (3m) on apigw-hosted-eu. AlertID=agw-502-wave-3412349920 :eyes:

paul: I'm oncall — scaling inference pool + bumping circuit-breaker timeout to 10s for streaming routes to reduce fail-fast. Enabling model-fallback to `rwf-open-7b-compat` for bursts. Will watch for error decline.

ken: Seeing auth-proxy 502s correlated with same timeframe. KMS token refresh latencies spiked ~03:19-03:26 UTC. Logs: ```auth-proxy error connection reset by peer; upstream KMS 504``` Might be transient KMS throttling.

maria: Adding notes — we also have an ingress keepalive TTL quirk that causes sticky-session churn under high fanout. If session affinity flips, long-running streaming gets reset. Quick mitigation: decrease `max_concurrent_requests_per_conn` on the apigw side and increase `keepalive_timeout` on the inference side. Patch suggestion below.

maria: Patch (hotfix candidate): ```- name: apigw-config
  proxy:
    max_concurrent_requests_per_conn: 4
+   session_affinity: cookie
+   keepalive_timeout_seconds: 90
```

paul: Applying a conservative change now: set `max_concurrent_requests_per_conn=3` and enable cookie affinity for the EU apigw. Rolling in 3 AZs, will watch metrics.

ops-bot: DEPLOY event: apigw-config rollout started by paul at 03:28 UTC — rollout id r-341234-1

ken: Repro steps from SRE side to validate: run a 200-concurrency streaming client against eu endpoint with long payloads and track `stream_conn_lifetime` + `proxy_conn_resets`. I'll run a run locally and post results.

alyssa: Support update: I told AcmeCorp we have an active mitigation and they're asking for ETA on full root cause and whether their in-flight requests will be retried. They want a timeline for full restore.

paul: Short update: 5xx rate fell ~60% after the affinity/keepalive toggle; a few customers still seeing higher p95. Still seeing auth-proxy KMS errors in the same windows, need root cause triage.

maria: Hypothesis: KMS refresh spike caused auth-proxy to intermittently return 502, which coupled with apigw connection churn triggered streaming resets. Two-layer failure: (1) KMS throttling during token refresh, (2) apigw session affinity/keepalive misconfig under fanout.

ken: Support logs from 03:20: ```[auth-proxy] refresh_token request 429 from kms (retrying) -> backlog -> upstream timeouts -> 502 to client``` Putting a short-lived rate limiter on the refresh path would reduce bursts.

paul: Immediate action items (assigned):
- paul: keep affinity enabled and monitor for 2 hours (complete monitor at 05:30 UTC)
- maria: prepare hotfix PR to make `session_affinity=cookie` default for EU apigw and hardened keepalive (PR #temp-keepalive)
- ken: add short-term client-side retry/backoff guidance to support playbook and add KMS throttling dashboards; try repro test and paste artifacts here
- alyssa: send customer comms update — timeline + mitigation + ask if they want retries on their client side
- support-jay: consolidate customer traces and escalate KMS vendor contact if more 429s appear

ops-bot: NOTE: incident-note logged to opslog with incident id inc-3412349999 at 03:40 UTC

maria: I'll open the hotfix PR in the next 20m and include integration test that simulates concurrent streaming connections flipping sessions.

ken: Repro run results: simulated 250 concurrent streams for 10m, with KMS delay introduced -> observed connection resets drop from 4% -> 0.8% after affinity change. Attaching short graph snapshot (upload link).

paul: Good signal. We'll keep the fallback model active for bursts for another 6 hours. If auth-proxy KMS 429s continue, escalate to infra/vendor.

alyssa: I'll send the customer an interim note: summary, temporary mitigations, expected timeline for RCA (EOD local) and offer a follow-up call.

support-jay: Customer replied: appreciated — asked for request ids for the failed invocations so they can reconcile on their side. I'll forward once ken/maria paste traces.

maria: Post-incident follow-ups (owners):
- Owner: maria -> full postmortem writeup (due +72h)
- Owner: ken -> add KMS throttling alerting and refresh rate limiter proposal (due +48h)
- Owner: eng-runtime -> evaluate long tail session affinity defaults and run longer soak tests (due +7d)
- Owner: support -> update public playbook + templated comms (due +24h)

paul: Closing note: no customer data exposure. If error rate climbs again, we'll reopen full war room. For now monitoring at p95 trending down. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. incident_id=inc-3412349999
